📥📤 Data Backup & Restore

📤 Export Data (Download Backup)

Download all selected module data as a JSON backup file. You can restore this file later.

📥 Import Data (Restore Backup)

Upload a previously exported JSON backup file to restore your data. Existing records will be merged.

☁️ Cloud Sync (Firebase)

Data is automatically synced to the cloud when you work. Use these buttons for manual sync.

⚠️ If sync not working: Open this file via local server (not file://). Run: npx serve in this folder.

📊 Google Sheets Database — all modules

📄 Google Sheet Sync (FICO Module)

Every FICO module (Chart of Accounts, Journal Entry, AP, AR, Bank Reconciliation, Cheque, Fund Transfer, Asset Accounting, Cost Center, Budget Allocation, Cost Allocation) is auto-pushed (a few seconds after saving) to its own tab in your linked Google Sheet. Use these buttons to push everything right now, or test the connection.

📄 Google Sheet Sync (SD Module)

Customer Master is auto-pushed (a few seconds after saving) to its own "Customer" tab in your separate SD Google Sheet. Use these buttons to push everything right now, or test the connection.
